g.title: psg
g.text: Two PSGs behind one vendored system core; the MrZ80 wrapper adds AY-style SELECT latches, a mixer register window and a silent-at-reset pan sequencer.

g.title: seq
g.text: at reset the PSG registers are 0 so no tone,
but the mixer's DC filter takes ~12 ms per
time constant to centre the DAC's constant
level - an audible thump. So: mute both
panning, clear phase invert, restore master
A later OSD change rewrites only the six
gains of each side, so software's master
volume, invert, bass and treble survive it

g.title: pan
g.text: 0 Mono all six channels at 64 both sides
1 ABC A left, B centre, C right
2 ACB A left, C centre, B right
channel never vanishes from one ear; the
per-side gain sum stays 384 in every mode
so loudness does not change. Device 2

g.title: exp
g.text: file stays in the tree, uncompiled
